question: Does evaluating complete incoming base CSR rows for all direct readers of seven real event ports fit the six-pass optimistic MRI budget, and how many readers are marked visual or specialized?
decision: This is an anatomical/metadata screen for ChatGPT row-selector, not its full effective operator plan. A cost failure for all direct base readers does not rule out pruning overwritten rows; a pass does not validate dynamics.
cost_model: Five complete stored-edge passes plus 229 fast calls each reading every nonzero incoming base edge of selected rows, no setup, no specialized costs. This is conditional on that row kernel; not a lower bound for all algorithms.
